hypotheses.mechanism: Persistent two-sided trade activity (not single burst) predicts continued attention and lower immediate exit failure while preserving right-tail upside
hypotheses.failure_condition: OOF utility does not beat C1/C2/C3 after BH correction, or right-tail not repeatable across token/deployer/time

hypotheses.mechanism: Liquidity accretion/stability regimes differ from withdrawal regimes in fatal risk and recoverable WETH fraction
hypotheses.failure_condition: Risk head does not reduce fatal rate vs universe baseline at matched capacity

hypotheses.mechanism: Growth in independent buyers/sellers with falling concentration marks healthier participation than wash/concentrated flow
hypotheses.failure_condition: No OOF lift vs price-path baseline after multiplicity correction

hypotheses.mechanism: Deployer PIT history (prior pools, prior fatal rates known before decision) separates chronic rug factories from cleaner issuers
hypotheses.failure_condition: Deployer features unavailable or do not improve utility after embargoed OOF

hypotheses.mechanism: Joint states of volatility, depth proxy, and flow mark transitions into right-tail continuation versus blow-off collapse
hypotheses.failure_condition: Price-path-only model already saturates; joint state adds no incremental OOF utility

hypotheses.mechanism: Currently buyable/sellable pools still differ in future permanent unsellability; risk head can veto without killing all directional opportunity
hypotheses.failure_condition: Fatal rate of selected set not below condition-universe baseline, or EXECUTION_RISK_DOMINATES
